title: Uninstall an app you no longer need
summary: Remove an app from Settings, Installed apps, and answer the security prompt yourself.

steps.say: Open Settings, click Apps on the left, then click Installed apps.

checks.prompt: Does the Settings page header read Installed apps, with a list of apps?

hints: Press the Windows key and I for Settings. Apps is in the left column.
Right-click the Start button and choose Installed apps.
steps.why: Installed apps lists everything on the PC in one place.

steps.say: Click Search apps above the list and type part of the app's name.

checks.prompt: Has the app list been filtered by a search term?

hints: The search box is at the top of the list, under the page title.
Scroll the list instead. It is sorted by name by default.
steps.why: Searching saves scrolling through a long list.

steps.say: Click the three dots at the right end of the app's row.

checks.prompt: Is a small menu open with Uninstall in it?

hints: The three dots sit next to the app's size and date.
Press Tab to reach the row's button, then press Enter.
steps.why: The three dots menu holds Modify, Move and Uninstall.

steps.say: Click Uninstall, then Uninstall again to confirm. This can't be undone; you would need to install it again.

checks.prompt: Has an uninstall started, or has the app gone from the list?

hints: Check the app name first. Press Escape if you change your mind.
Some programs open their own uninstaller window. Follow its steps.
steps.why: Removing apps you don't use frees space and declutters Start.

steps.say: If a Windows security prompt asks to allow changes, read it and click Yes yourself.
hints: The screen dims when this prompt appears. Only you can answer it.
If no prompt appears, say done and continue.
steps.why: Windows asks you directly before a program changes the system.

steps.say: Wait for the uninstall to finish and check the app is gone from the list. Say done when it is.

checks.prompt: Is the app no longer listed in Installed apps?

hints: Some apps take a minute. The list updates when they finish.
Search for the name again to confirm nothing is left.
steps.why: Checking the list confirms the app is fully removed.
